name: Goldberg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow in the proportions 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Goldberg (a bull's head above a red castle on yellow).
history: The flag was designed by the Schwerin heraldist Heinz Kippnick and approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 20 April 1998.

features.role: Goldberg arms — bull's head and castle on yellow
